purpose: Independent environmental layer for the ODSP ecological hypothesis: solar phase alone does not identify thermal and hydroclimatic seasonal context. Stop adding endpoints to the same nine GPS birds. This is a database-first geographic pilot, NOT animal-response validation or a globally representative ecological law.
prior_exposure: Serengeti 2010-2012 climate/NDVI and all existing camera/GPS outcomes are known. New selected-grid 2018-2023 climate values have not been read. No study, species, location or year is selected for a favorable effect.

sampling.land_source_hash_authority: GeoPandas geodatasets naturalearth.land catalogue; Natural Earth public-domain land polygons
sampling.eligibility: Point strictly inside original land union and at least 0.25 coordinate-degrees from its boundary. This is a coarse land-screen, not a habitat or biome classification.
sampling.selection: One land-eligible point per latitude x longitude-sector: minimum SHA256 of the UTF-8 string 'ODSP-macroclimate-20261019|{latitude:.2f}|{longitude:.2f}'. Empty strata remain empty; no hand-picked replacements.
sampling.roster_lock: Write all candidate decisions and selected-sites JSON/CSV plus SHA256 BEFORE requesting any weather. Never replace failed sites using weather values or retry a different grid cell.
sampling.target_population: Only this fixed stratified geographic pilot. Not a random sample of all land area, habitats, animals, independent ecoregions, or the catalogue of tracking studies. Equatorial |latitude|<15, polar and many islands are outside scope.

source.provider: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API, fixed ERA5 model; C3S/ECMWF reanalysis, not direct field measurements
source.timezone: Fixed Etc/GMT offset rounded from longitude/15, no DST; dates approximate local mean-solar days within half an hour, not changing civil clocks.
source.missingness: Record failures and nulls without fabrication. Pair only when all required source days and antecedent-30-day values exist. No post-result variable or source replacement.
source.reproducibility: Retain source response JSON, exact request URLs, resolved coordinates, dates, units, raw-response SHA256 and a typed SQLite/CSV database. A locally computed response hash is a snapshot fingerprint, not a provider-attested checksum.

astronomy.summer_anchor: June 21 for Northern Hemisphere, December 21 for Southern Hemisphere. Increasing-daylength branch BEFORE local summer maximum, decreasing branch AFTER it. This avoids treating the Northern December branch as if it were the Southern branch.
astronomy.candidate_dates: Each side 21..160 days from the anchor. Source branches are never inferred from temperature or rainfall.
astronomy.daylength: NOAA fractional-year declination with zenith 90.833 degrees at site latitude; label all tolerance statements as modeled photoperiod.
astronomy.matching: One-to-one maximum-cardinality/minimum-total-absolute-daylength-difference bipartite assignment, <=2 minutes; no date reused. Astronomy only, before climate outcomes. Fixed dummy penalty exceeds the total feasible mismatch range.

endpoints.primary: Mean declining-minus-increasing daily mean air temperature at matched modeled photoperiod, per site and local-summer cycle.
secondary: same difference in daily maximum air temperature
same difference in prior-30-day precipitation sum
same difference in prior-30-day climatic water balance sum(precipitation - reference ET0)
endpoints.water_balance_scope: Climatic supply-minus-reference-demand index. NOT measured soil moisture, actual evapotranspiration, edible forage, habitat quality or NDVI.
endpoints.signs: Report all point/cycle effects, missingness and counts; joint warmer/cooler x wetter/drier quadrants use the signs of mean temperature and 30-day P-ET0 differences. These are descriptive signs, not significance tests.
endpoints.replication: Five repeated annual cycles per selected site, not independent climate regions; paired days autocorrelated. No p-values or population confidence intervals. Summarize site-balanced means and within-site year sign stability without inflating N.
endpoints.validation: Constant environmental series must yield zero contrasts; hemisphere reversal, matching cardinality, missing-data propagation and database counts tested on fixtures before source execution.

delivery: One bounded original-source run, all-candidate and selected-site records, daily and matched-date tables, site/cycle summaries, SQLite database, raw snapshots and a claim-limited ecological report. Do not merge/replace historical PR267 results.
falsifiers: A uniform declining-branch warmer/wetter story fails if held-fixed geographical sites give opposite signs, or signs change among years.
No support for a predicted context is not evidence that animal behavior is absent.
Even consistent climate signs cannot establish animal diel reallocation; later animal-data integration is a different outcome with sampling-effort requirements.
